title: DWG-origin paper-space VIEWPORT output projection and peer evidence review
scope: Research refresh plus local adapter and layout-preflight implementation for PAR-122; no DWG parser/API-field change or native CAD qualification.

sources.supports: Group 68 is -1 for on/off-screen or inactive due to $MAXACTVP, 0 for off, and positive for active stacking order; group 69 is the viewport ID.
doesNotSupport: a requirement that groups 68 and 69 be equal
native CAD acceptance of this implementation

sources.observed: Open PR page describes a multi-layout blank-sheet issue from using entmode instead of resolved owner blocks, resets counters per layout block, and proposes equal positive group 68/69 values. The page presents contributor measurements of 13,941 viewports in 1,170 files and, in a later comment, 13,892 in 1,174 files across 1,657 drawings; these counts are inconsistent and not independently reproduced. The reduced current revision excludes a separate ordinary-block negative-ID proposal.
doesNotSupport: normative DXF semantics beyond Autodesk documentation
independent confirmation of the corpus figures or ODAFileConverter comparison
local libdxfrw failure or support qualification

sources.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files, version 5.4.1, local copy, §§20.4.1-20.4.2 and §20.4.84, printed pp. 106-111 and 210-211
sources.role: authoritative DWG common entity/handle and LAYOUT record layout
sources.supports: The LAYOUT stores the associated paperspace BLOCK_RECORD handle (330) and last-active viewport handle (331); common entity data and handle references are version-scoped. This source was used with the real local AC1021 observation; it is not a claim that the R13-R14-only entmode text applies unchanged to AC1021.
doesNotSupport: general inference of an owner from entmode or block name alone
semantic support for every viewport in every DWG version

localSourceFinding.before: DRW_Viewport DWG reset uses zero for vpstatus/vpID; dx_iface forwarded them. The output projection already handled one ownerless current-space case, but validateLayoutGraph required every non-null LAYOUT 331 target to carry an explicit parentHandle equal to the associated BLOCK_RECORD, blocking real parser-delivered DWG current-space viewports.
localSourceFinding.change: For DWG-origin paper-space viewports, layout preflight now accepts either an explicit exact owner or the narrowly inferred current-space case: one typed PaperSpace VIEWPORT in mBlock/ENTITIES with no parent handle, where the associated BLOCK_RECORD is the unique canonical *PAPER_SPACE and has the reciprocal backlink to that exact LAYOUT. The existing writer projection then assigns per-layout sequential positive status/ID values. DXF-origin, named-block ownerless, wrong-space/type, duplicate, unresolved, or ambiguous cases remain rejected. Retained entities are not mutated; model-space, ordinary-block, and DXF-origin viewport values stay literal.
localSourceFinding.statusAndIdEquality: An output-only convention informed by LibreDWG PR #1406; not treated as a normative DXF requirement.

generatedControls: ASCII and binary two-layout controls with two viewports per layout and counters restarting per owner.
Explicit entity owner and the one implied current-paper-space fallback.
LAYOUT 331 targeting an ownerless current-space viewport succeeds only on the DWG-origin path; DXF-origin equivalent is rejected while preserving a sentinel destination.
Emitted LAYOUT 331 resolves through the handle remap to the projected ownerless current-space VIEWPORT.
DXF-origin literal values, model-space and ordinary-block preservation.
Unresolved and ambiguous owners are rejected before replacing a sentinel destination; corrected unresolved-owner retry uses the same exporter.
Retained source viewport fields remain unchanged after projection.

localDwgIntegrationProbe.interpretation: The sample independently confirms parser delivery of the LAYOUT/BLOCK_RECORD/ownerless-current-viewport relation and demonstrates that the previous owner check was a false blocker. The reader is partial and the full export is stopped by separate unsupported carriers; neither run qualifies DWG conversion.

limitations: The real sample is private diagnostic input; partial reader integrity plus failed serializer preflight means there is no successful external-DWG output witness.
No external converter, native FreeCAD/LibreCAD application, or broad suite was run.
DWG viewport-count/handle-list semantics, shade-target census, CLI composition, and external/native acceptance remain open.
The working tree already contains unrelated uncommitted changes in the touched files, so this slice is not committed.
